title: Quickstart Accelerator: ecosystem map, microcopy, and adaptive screenshot set
creator: Asha Patel
description: Refresh the Quickstart landing experience with an 'Accelerator' ecosystem map that clarifies developer paths (hosted -> dedicated -> private), a compact set of adaptive product screenshots for three screen sizes, and tightened microcopy for CTAs, step labels, and tooltip hints. Goal is to reduce first-run confusion and improve conversion from sign-up to first API call by making the flow clearer and scannable.
acceptance_criteria: Ecosystem map communicates three deployment paths and recommended next steps per persona (Engineer, Platform, Security)
Primary hero/below-fold screenshots produced in 3 responsive breakpoints with redwood Console state showing 'first API call' flow
Microcopy reviewed and approved by PM and Content: concise CTAs, 7 words max where possible, consistent voice
Figma frames handed off with export-ready slices and chrome-less PNGs for docs and marketing
A/B test hypothesis and success metrics defined (10% lift target in quickstart-to-api event rate)
updates: 2026-02-28: Initial brief captured with PM (Marisol Vega). Scope: hero + mid-page ecosystem map + 3 responsive screenshots.
2026-03-03: Wireframes completed and reviewed in sync — PM requested clearer separation of 'hosted' vs 'private' benefits; removed long-form bullets in map nodes.
2026-03-06: Visual comps v1 uploaded to Figma; engineering noted screenshot states should include token creation step for accuracy (ENG-51432).
2026-03-09: Content audit done — microcopy tightened. Suggested CTAs: 'Try hosted API' / 'Reserve capacity' / 'Deploy privately'. Sent to Content for tone pass (Asha).
2026-03-11: Accessibility pass started: increased contrast on map lines, added aria-label recommendations for interactive SVG nodes.
2026-03-12: Design review session with PM and Solutions Eng — feedback captured; moving to final comps and export. Assigned QA for visual QA checklist.
design_review: Decision: Use stacked card approach for persona-specific paths instead of radial spokes to improve scanability.
Trade-off: extra vertical space on mobile accepted to preserve legibility of node descriptions.
Feedback: Reduce decorative gradients, rely on system colors for theming; this simplifies on-prem branding variants.
Action items: Add micro-interaction notes for hover states and deep-link anchors (Liam).
handoff_notes: Export specs: 2x and 3x PNGs for mobile/retina. Provide SVG for interactive map with labeled group IDs.
Dev notes: include example Console state JSON for screenshot population; coordinate with ENG-51432 for sample tokens/stubs.
Testing: Visual QA checklist created and shared with QA channel: #qa-design.
